finding: The route whose documented price is "the invoice amount" quotes 1000 USDC when there is no invoice: 402, amount 1000000000 units of USDC at six decimals, under scheme upto (a ceiling, not a fixed price) with maxTimeoutSeconds 3600 rather than the 300 every priced browse route uses. The request body was the empty JSON object, which identifies no invoice at all. Whether a payment at that figure would be accepted or captured is NOT measured: nothing was paid and nothing was signed. What is measured is that an unresolved invoice is quoted a ceiling rather than refused, which is what the vendor's own skill is protecting against when it tells the agent running it to cap maxPayment just above the price.
